input.body:
Dear Student Finance Office,

I am writing on behalf of the family of [PERSON_1] (Student ID [STUDENT_ID_1]), who holds an unconditional offer for the MSc Finance (full-time, 12 months), starting 18 January 2027.

Before any payment is made, could you please confirm with us:

1. Admission: that [PERSON_1] (Student ID [STUDENT_ID_1]) has a confirmed place on the MSc Finance starting 18 January 2027.

2. Fees: the full tuition fee statement for 2026/27, including the deposit (if any) and its due date, and whether the Kingsgate Global Excellence Scholarship of GBP 4,000 awarded to [PERSON_1] has been applied to the account.

3. Payment details: the university's bank account details on official letterhead (account name, account number, sort code/SWIFT/BIC and bank name), and the exact payment reference the bank needs (we understand this is the Student ID).

4. Deadlines: any deadlines for the deposit and the balance that we must meet.

Thank you very much.

Kind regards,
CarryPay, on behalf of the family

**Instalment plans received** — Kingsgate offered two plans (open until 9 November):
- Two instalments: £17,775 + £17,775, no fee
